Headings: About Us | Join The Team Homepage forms: 0 Visible homepage text: Drift is a new family-run restaurant opening 7th November 2026 - 36 Water Street, Skipton. Find us on Facebook OUR MENUS BOOK TABLE About Us Water Street means a lot to us. Five out of the six of us went to Water Street Primary School, so this really does feel like coming home. We’re Skipton born and bred, and after years of dreaming about opening a restaurant in our hometown, Drift is our next big step. Fourteen years ago, we took a leap of faith and took over The White Horse Inn in Thornton, and we’re proud to say we’re still there today. You can find us at The White Horse Inn, Well Heads, Thornton, BD13 3SJ, or call 01274 834268 . After the success of The White Horse, we’ve always wanted to create something closer to home. Somewhere relaxed, welcoming and full of the kind of food we love to eat ourselves. People often ask what style of food we cook, but we’ve never liked being boxed in. Our menu will be guided by good ingredients, proper cooking and dishes that simply taste great. If we’re proud to eat it ourselves, you’ll find it at Drift. We’re dedicated to creating a warm, friendly atmosphere with excellent food, genuine hospitality and great service. We can’t wait to welcome you through the doors. Join The Team As we get ready to open, we're now looking for: Full-time Sous Chef Full-time Apprentice Chef Full-time Front of House Manager Part-time Front of House Staff Part-time Cleaner Part-time Kitchen Porters If you’re interested in joining us, please send your CV, along with your notice period or availability and salary expectations, to info@driftskipton.co.uk .
